create_exception_ApiError: create an ApiError exception with a message, HTTP status code, and error code
raise_exception_ResponseNotFoundError: raise a ResponseNotFoundError exception when a requested response is not found
raise_exception_ExternalUnauthenticatedE: raise an ExternalUnauthenticatedError when external auth fails for unauthenticated users
